title: 第1011章 回到祁州第1010章 持香而行
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
“就一个白天的时间。”
方正闻言点了点头。
一个白天的时间，就能将叶家藏经阁内所有藏书的内容记在脑海当中，已经是很快了。
“叶兄，不知其余三大世家，哪一个离叶家比较近。”
方正直接问道，已经准备前往下一个世家了。
他这次来四大世家的藏经阁内，除了想要阅遍藏经阁内的功法武学之外。
最主要的目的就是为了寻找关于九州的线索。
四大世家底蕴深厚，历史悠久。
要是有九州的线索，极有可能存在于四大世家之内。
所以藏经阁就成为了他的首选。
可惜刚才他在脑海当中大概搜索了一下内容。
却并没有找到关于九州的记载。
现在只能尽快前往其余三大世家，看看他们那边有没有什么线索了。
否则以景无心的行事作风，之后估计很难有机会离开道观。
“离叶家最近的，那就是皇甫家了。”
叶澜停顿了一下，补充道：“不过虽然离叶家最近，但实际路途却非常遥远。
你想要前往那边，就算通过传送阵，也得花费不少时间。”
“我明白了，多谢叶兄告知。”
“方正兄弟客气了，既然如此，我送你离开叶家。”
“好。”

两人的身影很快就离开此处。
不久之后，方正的身影就独自出现在第一次抵达叶家所在的街道上。
“老怪物，送我去皇甫家。”
方正直接对着虚空说道。
在回来的路上，他就已经想过了。
以自己对景无心的重要性来说，这老怪物肯定会盯着他的。
那与其自己辛辛苦苦跑去皇甫家。
倒不如让景无心这个老怪物送他过去。
事实证明方正猜测的没错。
在方正这句话落下的瞬间，街道上就已经看不见方正的身影。
.........
九州海外。
三十一道身影正在以极快的速度前进着。
李言手持阵盘，带着众人不停传送，中间没有半点休息。
算算距离，他们此刻离祁州应该也没多远了。
content_en:
"Just one day."
Fang Zheng nodded after hearing this.
In one day, it is already very fast to memorize the contents of all the books in the Yejia Sutra Pavilion.
"Brother Ye, I don't know which of the other three major families is closer to the Ye family."
Fang Zheng asked directly, already preparing to go to the next aristocratic family.
This time he came to the Sutra Pavilion of the Four Great Families, in addition to wanting to read all the Kung Fu and martial arts in the Sutra Pavilion.
The main purpose is to find clues about Kyushu.
The four major aristocratic families have profound foundations and long histories.
If there are any clues about Kyushu, it is very likely that they exist within the four major families.
Therefore, Tibetan Scripture Pavilion became his first choice.
It's a pity that he just searched the content in his mind.
But no records about Kyushu were found.
Now we can only go to the other three major families as soon as possible to see if they have any clues.
Otherwise, with Jing Wuxin's behavior, it would be difficult to leave the Taoist temple in the future.
"The one closest to the Ye family is the Huangfu family."
Ye Lan paused and added: "However, although it is closest to the Ye family, the actual distance is very far.
If you want to go there, even if you pass through the teleportation array, it will take a lot of time. "
"I understand, thank you Brother Ye for informing me."
"Brother Fangzheng is too polite. In that case, I will send you away from the Ye family."
"Okay."
The two figures left here quickly.
Soon after, Fang Zheng's figure appeared alone on the street where he first arrived at Ye's house.
"Old monster, send me to Huangfu's house."
Fang Zheng said directly to the void.
He had already thought about it on the way back.
Considering his importance to Jing Wuxin, this old monster would definitely keep an eye on him.
Instead of running to Huangfu's house all the hard work.
It would be better to let Jing Wuxin, an old monster, send him there.
Facts proved that Fang Zheng's guess was correct.
The moment Fang Zheng said these words, Fang Zheng was no longer visible on the street.
.........
Kyushu Overseas.
Thirty-one figures are moving forward at extremely fast speeds.
Li Yan held the array disk and led everyone to teleport without any rest in between.
Calculating the distance, they shouldn't be that far away from Qizhou at this moment.
